title: Figure 6: inertial frame bias drive surface plot with outer hull, inner hull and crew zone
description: 3D mesh surface plot of a scalar potential with a raised ridge around a flat central region; callouts mark the "Outer Hull," "Inner Hull" (blue ring) and "Crew Safe Zone" (green centre). Captioned "Figure 6. Inertial Frame Bias Drive and Vehicle Zones. [Credit: M. Millis]." The surrounding text discusses secondary consequences for cockpit design and mixed operational regimes.
